trustRules: Hide headline is an on-screen preview control; production must retain the member privacy preference.

Timber is AI support. Notes belong to the member and must never send automatically.

starterExample.note: All records are invented to demonstrate the interface. A rise is not labelled normal, and symptom causes or dosing decisions are not inferred. Only the four entered doses are shown; unlogged later treatment is unknown.

learningContract.helped: Build on the useful thing while preserving variety.
learningContract.didNotFit: Change timing, effort or format using the stated reason.
learningContract.triedDidNotHelp: Change the approach; do not offer the rejected suggestion again.
learningContract.didNotTry: Ask what got in the way neutrally; no failure or completion inferred.
learningContract.record: Store suggestion identity, category, offered/accepted dates, outcome and reason; each interpretation must retain provenance.
acceptance: Feedback changes the next eligible suggestion in the required way.
Same-account feedback and rejection history survive refresh.
Two accounts cannot read or affect each other’s memory, logs or suggestions.
Resolved or hidden quotes are not repeated inappropriately.
Push and lock-screen previews contain no personal quotes or sensitive context.
learningContract.productionStatus: Unverified; this disconnected preview is not production acceptance.

claimsRule: No unverified nobody-else or unique-aftercare market claim.

latestFeedback.day2WarmLine: You don’t have to work it all out today. A note about how you feel is enough.
latestFeedback.liveEvidenceRule: Counts must be deduplicated dated replies belonging to the current account, not accepted plans or inferred completion. Rejected options must be explicitly recorded before claiming they were left out. Treatment dates and medicine/dose come from member entries. Without evidence, use neutral copy or ask one question.
